source: R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H]), A=00+11+22, B=01+12, D=10-21, C=02+34, E=20+33, F=23, G=30, I=32, H=04, on 4x5. Its PPT and SN>=3 were independently checked by exact arithmetic and written reasoning in frontier-20261029-kg45-source-check.py SHA256 8a9f5ba28a8c90e7ccc197e13b39754552c8c3ee38f76e2fab5bc31e69be40b2. All ket notation is unnormalized.
rank_two_path: Define U=G+I=|3> tensor (|0>+|2>), V=A+C+E, Z=(|0>+|2>) tensor (|3>+|4>)=|03>+|04>+|23>+|24>. Then for every complex t, X(t)=U+tV+t^2 Z equals (|3>+t(|0>+|2>)) tensor ((|0>+|2>)+t(|3>+|4>))+t|1> tensor |1>, so SR(X(t))<=2. This is a simultaneous actual-source rank-two curve, not a selected instance of any held episode.
torus_and_inequality: Let W be any effective T^2-invariant 2-block-positive 4x5 witness for this source. Under that torus U has two distinct characters, V has three distinct characters (A,C,E), and Z has four distinct characters; these character sets are pairwise disjoint. Thus with w_X=<X|W|X>, g=w_G+w_I>=0, a=w_A+w_C+w_E, z=w_Z>=0, we have <X(t)|W|X(t)>=g+|t|^2*a+|t|^4*z. Positivity for every t yields a>=-2*sqrt(g*z), with the zero cases understood continuously. The source pairing is Tr(W R)=a+s+3g, where s=w_B+w_D+2(w_C+w_E)+3(w_F+w_H)>=0. Therefore every detecting W satisfies 2*sqrt(g*z)>s+3g, in particular g>0 and z>(9/4)g. With the fixed rational SOS-search threshold Tr(W R)<-1/4, the sharper necessary inequality is 2*sqrt(g*z)>s+3g+1/4. Because averaging any detector over the source's compact T^2 preserves 2-block positivity and the source pairing, there is no loss of generality in imposing these inequalities on its torus-averaged representative.
failed_naive_candidate: Let P_K be the orthogonal projector onto ker R. For any real alpha>=0 and epsilon>0, W_naive=P_K+alpha([B]+[D])-epsilon[A] is NOT 2-block positive: P_K U=P_K V=0, P_K Z=|03>+|24>, B and D are orthogonal to all three coefficients, and <A|X(t)>=3t. Thus <X(t)|W_naive|X(t)>=2|t|^4-9epsilon|t|^2<0 for sufficiently small nonzero t. In particular alpha=epsilon=1/100 makes Tr(W_naive R)=-1/100 but the exact SR2 vector X(1/10) gives -7/10000; detection alone is not an SR2-positivity certificate.

exact_check.observed: Integer polynomials check all 40 3x3 minors of X(t) identically zero, the (2,3,4) pairwise-disjoint torus-character sets, source generator orthogonality, exact ||P_K Z||^2=2, and the -7/10000 rank-two test together with -1/100 source pairing. The universal positivity inequality follows from the written real quadratic argument; this is exact arithmetic, not formal-kernel verification.

limits: A necessary condition and an invalid-ansatz diagnosis for a specific 4x5 source, not a 4x4 theorem and not an actual certified detector. No claim of novelty or independent review. The historical parent N4 UNKNOWN status is untouched, and the 4x4 PPT/SN>=3 target is open.
